description:
Returns a list of saved items matching any of the supplied SKUs (standard items only, max 100 SKUs).
SKUs that don't match any item are silently omitted — compare returned Sku values against your input to detect misses.

Args:
  - companyId (number): Company ID
  - skus (string[]): Array of SKU codes to look up (max 100)
name: machship_get_items_by_skus

errors.description: Validation errors returned by Machship, if any

title: Get Company Items by SKUs (Batch)
